title: Reality Gate — Source-Derived GDPa1 Viability Veto Pilot

cohort_rule.description: Derive N from pinned GDPa1 bytes at execution time. Include every unique antibody with non-empty VH/VL sequences and finite HIC, PR_CHO, and AC-SINS_pH7.4 measurements.

evaluation.inner_split: remaining source folds only; each remaining source fold held out once

dispositions.VETO: Out-of-fold high-confidence predicted violation of at least one primary viability boundary.
dispositions.UNKNOWN: No high-confidence veto; candidate remains eligible for experiment.

prior_work.CPG-002: INCONCLUSIVE_COVERAGE; no compensation separation established on GDPa1.
prior_work.RGV-001: Frozen independent GDPa3 external test; currently INCONCLUSIVE_EXTERNAL_COVERAGE because external truth was not accessible to CI.
prior_work.RGV-P34: Superseded as a scientific pilot before execution because it incorrectly hard-coded a remembered cohort count of 34 against a different historical constructor. Its coverage failure is not a biological result.

kill_condition: If the source-derived pilot returns NO_PILOT_VETO_SIGNAL, close the learned selector/veto line. Do not rescue it by changing cohort eligibility, viability thresholds, feature family, retention floor, avoidance floor, or enrichment bar after observing the result.
claim_boundary_if_signal: Exploratory within-GDPa1 evidence only: sequence-derived confidence vetoes enriched for experimentally defined developability failures while preserving the frozen clean-retention floor. This is not external validation, clinical prediction, or a generative-design claim.
